content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Jesus Cooke (E029)
Request: write access to Source Code

Two notes:
- Note 1 says: role Payroll Specialist, employment type full_time, recommendation write
- Note 2 says: role Payroll Specialist, employment type contractor, security training basic, recommendation read. Note 2 contradicts note 1, saying Security DB shows contractor (not full-time as previously noted).

So there's conflicting information. The security note (note 2) appears to be a correction: "Security DB shows Jesus Cooke (E029) is a contractor with basic security training (not full-time as previously noted)."

Policy:
- contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.
- Jesus has basic security training, so max is read.

Requested write exceeds maximum (read), so grant maximum = read.

The recommendation in note 2 is read. Note 1 was based on incorrect info.

So decision: read.

Evidence: Security DB indicates contractor with basic training; max access level is read; requested write exceeds policy, so grant read (the maximum).
